        score += 2
    elif dental_assistant.manual_dexterity in ['fair', 'poor']:

    elif dental_assistant.interpersonal_skills in ['fair', 'poor']:
        score += 1
    
    # Organization
    if dental_assistant.organization in ['excellent', 'good']:

    elif dental_assistant.organization in ['fair', 'poor']:
        score += 1
    
    return score

        score += 3
    elif counselor.cultural_competence == 'moderate':
        score += 2
    elif counselor.cultural_competence == 'low':
        score += 1
    
    return score
